gotjawal.name: Hangyeong-Joncheon Gotjawal (Jeju Island)
gotjawal.summary: Gotjawal is Jeju's forest on rough 'a'a lava fields: a dense evergreen and deciduous woodland growing straight out of jumbled basalt blocks, with mossy rocks, vines and ferns, never cleared for farming because the ground is too rough.

giant_redwood_forest.name: Tall Trees Grove, Redwood National Park
giant_redwood_forest.summary: Coast redwoods, the tallest trees on Earth (over 110 m), stand in fog-fed groves along Redwood Creek: thick red fibrous trunks rising from a fern and moss floor into a closed canopy far overhead.

takachiho_gorge.name: Takachiho Gorge (Gokase River, Miyazaki)
takachiho_gorge.summary: A narrow gorge the Gokase River cut through lava flows of Mount Aso: sheer walls of columnar basalt 80 to 100 m high stand a few metres apart over emerald water, with the Manai Falls dropping into it from the forested plateau above.
